intents_zh: fzf 搜尋 shell 歷史
code:
# zsh: add to ~/.zshrc
fzf-history-widget() {
  local selected
  selected=$(fc -rl 1 | awk '{$1=""; print substr($0,2)}' | awk '!seen[$0]++' \
    | fzf --tac --no-sort --height=40% --query="$LBUFFER")
  if [ -n "$selected" ]; then
    LBUFFER="$selected"
  fi
  zle reset-prompt
}
zle -N fzf-history-widget
bindkey '^R' fzf-history-widget
summary_zh: zsh Ctrl-R 換 fzf 歷史搜尋去重
